messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlashealth.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Private deployment playbook & owner RACI (Atlas Health)

Tom / Alice —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I’m kicking off the mutual action plan for Atlas Health’s private/VPC deployment. The goal of this thread is to:

- Align on owners (networking/VPN, IAM/KMS, deployment topology, security/compliance)
- Confirm a 6‑week evaluation sequence and gating criteria for go‑forward (PoC -> Pilot -> Production)
- Lock a kickoff meeting for next week to walk the MAP and run the initial network review

Proposed immediate outcomes:
1) Owner roster for each workstream (who’s on the hook from both sides)
2) Initial access checklist completed (VPN endpoints, CIDR exchange, KMS key handoff plan)
3) A shared MAP tracker we’ll update daily for blockers and artifacts

Attached: Redwood-MAP-Playbook-v1.xlsx (MAP template), private-deploy-network-sketch.pdf (high-level topology we’d like to validate).

Questions for you now: who are the engineers on your side we should expect for the network/VPN and security (IAM/KMS) conversations? Also, are there any scheduling constraints for the week of Apr 26?

Proposed kickoff: Tue Apr 27, 10:00–11:00 PT (I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock).

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood-MAP-Playbook-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: private-deploy-network-sketch.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Private deployment playbook & owner RACI (Atlas Health)

Vanessa —

Great — thanks for pulling this together. On our side:
- Networking/VPN: Alice Chen (SRE lead) will be primary; cc’d. She’ll handle IP planning and VPN tunnel tech.
- Security/IAM & KMS: Mark Gupta (Head of InfoSec) will own compliance and key policies.
- Program sponsor: myself (Tom Reynolds).

We can do Tue Apr 27 10:00 PT — that works. I attached our filled network questionnaire to save time.

One thing to flag: Atlas requires explicit HSM/KMS owner confirmation before we hand off test keys. Mark will need a quick note on Redwood’s KMS integration pattern (bring-your-own vs. Redwood-provisioned).

Thanks — see you Tue.

Tom

Atlas Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Private deployment playbook & owner RACI (Atlas Health)

Thanks Vanessa / Tom — quick owners + plan from the Redwood side so we’re explicit:

- Networking/VPN owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — I’ll lead CIDR exchange, VPN configuration, and staging tunnel setup.
- Deployment topology & infra lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole — will validate instance sizing, subnet layout, and autoscaling signals for Pilot.
- Security / Compliance liaison (Redwood): Neha Kapoor — I’ll coordinate SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagrams, and KMS integration requirements with Mark.
- Customer success & rollout coordinator (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — will run weekly status and capture acceptance criteria.

Short timeline (high level):
- Week 1 (Apr 26–30): Kickoff, questionnaire review, CIDR exchange, KMS owner decision point
- Week 2–3: VPN tunnel proof-of-concept, staging deploy, basic end-to-end smoke tests
- Week 4–5: Pilot with subset of traffic, performance baseline and cost estimate review
- Week 6: Production cutover readiness decision or extension cadence

Gate for Pilot -> Prod: successful secure tunnel, IAM roles & KMS key escrow verified, and smoke tests meeting latency/throughput thresholds.

Action items for Tue kickoff:
1) Confirm Atlas network contacts (Tom/Alice confirmed) and their VPN tech preference (IPsec vs. AWS Transit).
2) Determine KMS mode (BYOK vs Redwood-managed).
3) Share initial NAT/firewall rules and emergency contact list.

I’ll prepare a short runbook and a stub Terraform snippet showing expected network objects to accelerate the VPN PoC.

—Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Inline: quick bullet runbook to follow]

Tom / team — noted. I’ll own the topology validation and will bring a staging checklist to the kickoff. Two quick asks before the meeting:

1) Can Atlas share the preferred endpoint (load balancer) footprint? Single AZ vs multi-AZ for Pilot will change the sizing.
2) If you plan to use Transit Gateway, please indicate that (it affects route map examples I’ll bring).

I’ll also align with infra on a temporary monitoring dashboard and token rotation cadence for test keys.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Marissa Cole
Principal DevOps Engineer, Redwood Inference
